consequence.statement: Self-healing backoff delay calculation now correctly handles cases exceeding the maximum delay value, fixing incorrect behavior in the previous version.

original.statement: SelfHealBackOff delay calculation when exceeding maximum is fixed to work correctly.

decision.reason: [ev-8a18453dbaf5] is a one-line changelog bug-fix entry: the SelfHealBackOff delay is now calculated correctly when it would exceed the maximum. So self-heal retry timing can differ after the upgrade, but nothing says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. That makes a failure kind unsupported, and behavior-change (review) is the right class. The evidence says nothing about the old miscalculation or its impact, so the medium severity is not directly supported, and confidence is low.
